results.title: Flavinho de Papai
results.overview: People who have never had to do real work want to convince you that the best approach is to cut investments for those who are out there grinding every day.  Flávio Bolsonaro—who was accused of being a "ghost employee" in Jair’s office at the age of 19 and has always lived off his father—wants to cut the very things that have helped millions of Brazilians get ahead in life: social security, healthcare, education, the *Bolsa Família* welfare program, and labor rights.  This is the man who wants to be president of Brazil. If Flávio wins, you lose.

results.title: On Rescuing Democracy and the Rule of Law
results.original_title: On Rescuing Democracy and the Rule of Law
results.overview: After the 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall, volunteer American lawyers traveled to former Soviet Bloc countries to help usher in the transition to democracy and reform their legal systems. As global adherence to the rule of law has dangerously fallen in the last decade, two-time Academy Award winner Terry Sanders explores not just what caused the decline, but how we can preserve democracy and the rule of law into the future.

results.title: Our Last Movie About Lisbon
results.original_title: O Nosso Último Filme sobre Lisboa
results.overview: This is our last movie about Lisbon. The starting point is this question: If one day the water swallows this city, what will be the traces of the struggles we shared in these streets? The strength of affections and bodies in motion, determined to disrupt normality, brings us back to the surface. The trace of this struggle will be our ability to imagine together another city, another world

results.title: Drawing Three Thin Lines Up to the Length of the River
results.original_title: 川の長さにまで至る、三行の薄いしるべを引く
results.overview: To the left, there is the city, but to the right, the river flows. What is a river when your thoughts are more rapid than everything else? Two poets, Natsumi Aoyagi and Nobunari Mizushita, are having a back-and-forth kind of conversation and trying to get closer to the river. They exchange three-liner poems with each line written at such length and speed that it could stretch to the length of the river. Or not.

results.title: City Of Illusions
results.overview: We erase, rewrite, correct and create. Construction of the subway in Thessaloniki has been going on for over 20 years. Scientists, politicians and many others have been searching for and excavating artefacts of historic significance. These artefacts have been found, kept in secret and hidden. The city has been constantly erasing its centuries-long past, always carrying a new “me” in its underbelly of streets. Then, a woman is invited back to her motherland to save it from a contagious amnesia..
